ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio; approximately 75-80% high-intensity white/cream pixels across the central lobe surfaces, bounded by ~20-25% low-intensity black pixels along the trailing edges and peduncle junction.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white mass occupies the center of both lobes; a solid low-intensity black band follows the trailing edge and extends into a bifurcated dark region at the peduncle base; distinct low-intensity black punctate spots are clustered near the distal tips of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an approximate angle of 70 degrees; deep vertical indentation relative to the horizontal fluke axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations (5-10 pixel amplitude variations) along the distal halves of both lobes; extreme topographical irregularity at the tips due to biological encrustation protruding beyond the natural fluke boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly concave sweep along the trailing edge, transitioning to a convex curve on the leading edge towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of three light-brown circular clusters on the mid-left lobe; five similar tan circular clusters on the mid-right lobe; distinct circular black ring-like scars visible on the lower-right quadrant of the fluke.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct dark, unaligned linear strokes on the right lobe: one long diagonal mark approximately 15% of the lobe width and two shorter parallel marks closer to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on the distal tips of both lobes and along the right trailing edge, creating a jagged, non-biological edge profile; visible rake marks on the right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique circular black 'donut' scars located on the inner-lower region of the right lobe surface.
